needs_atom.missing: 'Exile two legendary cards from your graveyard: Until end of turn, each legendary card in your graveyard gains "You may play this card from your graveyard."' Re-checked after ontology round R13 (mapper wave 5, 2026-11-18): the cost has its form (R11: CostExile(Selector(QConst(2), CHOOSE, FAtom(SUPERTYPE_EQ 'Legendary'), zones=(Zone(GRAVEYARD, YOU),)))), and so has the permission (R13: a resolving PERMIT, lands True, DurationEot; a granted static PERMIT is refused as its second encoding). Missing: the set it covers. 'Gains' changes characteristics, so the cards are fixed as the effect begins (CR 611.2c; a card put into the graveyard later, or one that leaves and comes back, is not covered, CR 400.7). A resolving PERMIT over an ALL population is read whenever a card is played (verbs._v_permit), TARGET designates only chosen cards and `result` only what an instruction moved: no form designates every card that passes a filter at resolution. Evidence (runpack with that closest draft, scratch packs): Kethis's ability resolves with Sorin, Imperious Bloodlord in the graveyard, then Kykar, Wind's Fury is put into the graveyard and the menu offers it from there (stronger than printed); Sorin is castable (as printed). Sentence 1 maps: 'Legendary spells you cast cost {1} less to cast.' = CostModifier(filter=FAtom(SUPERTYPE_EQ 'Legendary'), controller_ref=YOU, delta=CostDeltaReduceGeneric(QConst(1))), Watcher of the Spheres' shape.
